label: Core work
summary: Core work, in Maaike's usage, refers to the central and defining activities that constitute the heart of her freelance practice. Community building is explicitly characterised as core work, sitting alongside conversation design as a foundational part of what Convocat does. It is the kind of work that shapes and redefines her business rather than sitting at the edges of it.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike arrives at the idea of core work through a process of reflection on what actually drives her freelance practice. In looking back at two years of running Convocat, she frames community building not as a side activity but as something that helped her reshape and redefine her core business. This suggests she uses the concept to distinguish work that is constitutive of her identity as a freelancer from work that is merely incidental to it.
open_questions: The passage gestures at community building having reshaped the core business, but does not fully explain what the core business looked like before that reshaping or what specifically changed.
It is not clear from the material whether core work is a stable category for Maaike or something she expects to keep evolving as her freelance career develops.
